note: Free university course materials for AI engineering/research curricula. kind='official page': official course page with public notes, slides or videos; url returned HTTP 200 at collection time and is the latest public offering found. kind='youtube': a lecture playlist on an official university or lecturer YouTube channel (Stanford Online, Prof. Joonseok Lee of SNU); playlist ids were read once from each channel's public /playlists page (YouTube robots.txt disallows /feeds/videos.xml, so RSS was not used). Only the first page of the Stanford Online playlists listing could be read, so that channel is covered partially. term is null when not stated. videos is an official playlist or channel link, or null when none is linked. Summaries are paraphrased from the official page or playlist description. No aggregators or paid platforms.

courses.title: Natural Language Processing with Deep Learning
courses.summary: A thorough introduction to cutting-edge neural networks for NLP, from word vectors and recurrent models to Transformers and large language models, with programming assignments and a final project.

courses.title: Language Modeling from Scratch
courses.summary: Students build their own language model end to end: pre-training data collection and cleaning, Transformer construction, efficient model training, and evaluation before deployment.

courses.title: Deep Learning for Computer Vision
courses.summary: A deep dive into deep learning architectures for visual recognition (classification, localization, detection), focusing on learning end-to-end models and implementing and training networks.

courses.title: Machine Learning
courses.summary: Broad introduction to machine learning and statistical pattern recognition: supervised learning, unsupervised learning, learning theory and bias/variance, and reinforcement learning and adaptive control.

courses.title: Transformers United (V6)
courses.summary: Weekly seminar of talks by researchers on Transformers and their applications across language, vision and other fields; open to auditors, with slides posted for each talk.

courses.title: Reinforcement Learning
courses.summary: Solid introduction to reinforcement learning, covering the core challenges and approaches including generalization and exploration, through lectures and written and coding assignments.

courses.title: Deep Multi-Task and Meta Learning
courses.summary: Multi-task learning, meta-learning and few-shot learning, including self-supervised pre-training (contrastive learning, masked language modeling) and transfer learning such as domain adaptation.

courses.title: Machine Learning Systems Design
courses.summary: An iterative framework for building real-world ML systems that are deployable, reliable and scalable: data management and engineering, feature engineering, model selection, training, deployment and monitoring.

courses.title: Systems for Machine Learning
courses.summary: How to reach high performance when training and serving deep learning models, addressing the infrastructure and lifecycle hurdles that limit performance at scale.

courses.title: Deep Generative Models
courses.summary: Probabilistic foundations and learning algorithms for deep generative models: VAEs, GANs, autoregressive models, normalizing flows, energy-based models and score-based (diffusion) models.

courses.title: Machine Learning with Graphs
courses.summary: Computational and modeling challenges of massive graphs: representation learning and graph neural networks, knowledge graph reasoning, web algorithms and social network analysis; slides are public.

courses.title: Large Language Models
courses.summary: Fundamentals of the modeling, theory, ethics and systems aspects of large language models, with online lecture notes on capabilities, data, training, parallelism, scaling laws and adaptation.

courses.title: Spoken Language Processing
courses.summary: Introduction to spoken language technology with an emphasis on dialog systems: deep learning for speech recognition, speech synthesis, affect detection and dialogue management, with hands-on homework.

courses.title: Natural Language Understanding
courses.summary: Natural language understanding with contextual representations and modern language models; can be taken online, with slides, recorded videos and Python notebooks.

courses.title: Machine Learning from Human Preferences
courses.summary: Graduate course on learning from human preferences: choice modelling, learning to predict choice, RLHF and DPO, assistance games and bandits, with applications to fine-tuning and personalization.

courses.title: Self-Improving AI Agents
courses.summary: Techniques for AI agents that improve through interaction: constitutional AI, verifiers, test-time compute scaling, search with LLMs, RL training, and LLMs augmented with tools, code and memory.

courses.title: Deep Learning
courses.summary: Foundations of deep learning: how to build neural networks and lead successful ML projects, covering CNNs, RNNs, LSTMs, Adam, dropout, batch normalization and initialization.

courses.title: Mining Massive Data Sets
courses.summary: Data mining and machine learning algorithms for very large data with MapReduce and Spark: locality-sensitive hashing, dimensionality reduction, recommendation systems, clustering and link analysis.

courses.title: Deep Reinforcement Learning
courses.summary: Practical deep RL algorithms that learn behavior from high-dimensional observations: learning from demonstrations, model-based and model-free RL, offline RL, with applications in robotics and language models.

courses.title: Agentic AI
courses.summary: Project course with lectures on the principles and research behind LLM-powered agents; students build a quarter-long project in agent methodology research or an applied assistant.

courses.title: Transformers & Large Language Models
courses.summary: The evolution of NLP methods, the core components of the Transformer and how they relate to LLMs, and techniques to improve model performance for real-world applications.

courses.title: Parallel Computing
courses.summary: Principles and engineering trade-offs of modern parallel computing systems, from multi-core CPUs and GPUs to AI accelerators, and the parallel programming techniques needed to use them well.

courses.title: Advanced Natural Language Processing
courses.summary: Introductory graduate NLP course on modern neural methods, covering the modeling, learning and inference algorithms; culminates in reimplementing and improving on a research paper.

courses.title: Deep Learning Systems: Algorithms and Implementation
courses.summary: The full stack of deep learning systems, from high-level model design to automatic differentiation to device-level efficient algorithms; students build a deep learning library from scratch.

courses.title: Large Language Models: Methods and Applications
courses.summary: Graduate course giving a holistic view of the current state of large language models, from how they are built and trained to how they are applied.

courses.title: Large Language Model Applications
courses.summary: Graduate course on applying core LLM technology to a wide range of practical, academic and exploratory applications.

courses.title: Generative AI
courses.summary: Machine learning techniques behind recent advances in generative modeling and foundation models; students understand, build and apply algorithms that generate text, images and other content.

courses.title: Introduction to Deep Learning
courses.summary: CMU's introductory deep learning course with lectures, recitations, bootcamps and homework, plus a class-notes book developed alongside the course.

courses.title: Machine Learning Systems
courses.summary: Design rationale of modern ML frameworks and system techniques to scale, reduce memory and offload to heterogeneous hardware, with case studies of LLM training and serving systems.

courses.title: Multimodal Machine Learning
courses.summary: Integrating language, speech, vision and other signals: representation, alignment, reasoning, generation, transference and quantification in multimodal machine learning.

courses.title: Large Language Model Systems
courses.summary: Engineering skills for training, serving, fine-tuning and evaluating LLMs on modern hardware and software stacks, so students can design and implement scalable LLM systems.

courses.title: Introduction to Robot Learning
courses.summary: How robots learn sequential decision-making: fundamentals of machine, deep, visual and reinforcement learning and how they apply to robot control.

courses.title: Deep Reinforcement Learning and Control
courses.summary: Developing agents that learn to sense and act by imitation, sparse rewards or curiosity, combining computer vision, robot control, reinforcement learning and language understanding.

courses.title: Machine Learning Systems
courses.summary: How a model written in a high-level language is lowered to kernels and run on GPUs and TPUs in a distributed way: autodiff, accelerators, distributed training, graph and memory optimizations.

courses.title: Large Language Model Agents
courses.summary: Fundamental concepts for LLM agents, including reasoning, planning and tool use, along with infrastructure and representative applications, taught with guest lecturers from industry and academia.

courses.title: Advanced Large Language Model Agents
courses.summary: Advanced topics in LLM agents: reasoning and planning, inference-time and post-training techniques, AI for mathematics, code generation and program verification.

courses.title: Agentic AI
courses.summary: Foundations of agentic AI (LLMs, reasoning, planning, agent frameworks and infrastructure) and applications such as code generation, robotics, web automation and scientific discovery.

courses.title: Deep Reinforcement Learning
courses.summary: Deep reinforcement learning: imitation learning, policy gradients, actor-critic, value-based and model-based RL, offline RL and exploration; lecture recordings from Fall 2023 are public.

courses.title: Deep Unsupervised Learning
courses.summary: Two areas of deep learning that need no labels: deep generative models and self-supervised learning, covering theoretical foundations and new applications.

courses.title: Introduction to Machine Learning
courses.summary: Theoretical foundations, algorithms and applications of machine learning across the full pipeline, from problem formulation and data to neural networks and modern deep learning.

courses.title: Machine Learning Systems
courses.summary: Research seminar on the hardware and software systems behind modern AI: ML frameworks, accelerators, distributed training and model serving, with paper presentations.

courses.title: Introduction to Deep Learning
courses.summary: Intensive bootcamp on deep learning fundamentals with applications in language, vision and biology, including large language models and generative AI, with hands-on labs.

courses.title: TinyML and Efficient Deep Learning Computing
courses.summary: Efficient machine learning and systems: model compression, pruning, quantization, efficient architectures, distributed training and efficient LLM and diffusion inference on resource-constrained hardware.

courses.title: Deep Generative Models
courses.summary: Seminar on concepts and applications of deep generative models, mainly in vision: VAEs, autoregressive models, GANs and diffusion models, from foundations to research frontiers.

courses.title: Advances in Computer Vision
courses.summary: Fundamental and advanced computer vision, from early vision to mid- and high-level vision, including machine learning basics and convolutional neural networks for vision.

courses.title: Generative AI with Stochastic Differential Equations: Flow Matching and Diffusion Models
courses.summary: Mathematical introduction to diffusion and flow models (SDEs, Fokker-Planck) with notes and labs; students build a latent diffusion model from scratch.

courses.title: Deep Learning
courses.summary: Fundamentals of deep learning in theory and practice: MLPs, CNNs, RNNs and Transformers, invariances, backpropagation, generalization, and applications to vision, language and robotics.

courses.title: Robotic Manipulation: Perception, Planning, and Control
courses.summary: Open course notes and lecture videos on robotic manipulation, covering perception, planning, control and learning-based approaches.

courses.title: Understanding Large Language Models
courses.summary: Research seminar on pre-trained language models: BERT/GPT/T5, mixture-of-experts and retrieval-based models, emergent capabilities, fine-tuning and adaptation, system design, security and ethics.

courses.title: Deep Dive into Large Language Models
courses.summary: Rigorous survey of current LLM research: model architecture, data preparation, pre-training, post-training, alignment and deployment, focused on conceptual understanding.

courses.title: Natural Language Processing
courses.summary: Basics of NLP: language modeling, representation learning, text classification, sequence tagging, machine translation and Transformers, including recent deep learning approaches.

courses.title: Deep Learning
courses.summary: Week-by-week lecture notes and videos on deep learning, including autoencoders, generative models, self-supervised learning, Transformers and energy-based models.

courses.title: Reinforcement Learning (Advanced Topics 2015)
courses.summary: David Silver's UCL reinforcement learning lectures: MDPs, dynamic programming, model-free prediction and control, function approximation, policy gradients, planning and exploration.

courses.title: Advanced Natural Language Processing
courses.summary: Advanced NLP course livestreamed on YouTube, with the schedule linking every lecture video, reading and assignment.

courses.title: Data Systems for Machine Learning

courses.title: Automatic Speech Recognition
courses.summary: Open course materials for automatic speech recognition: 18 lectures with public slides on signal analysis, acoustic modeling, and neural network approaches to speech recognition.

courses.title: Diffusion Models and Their Applications
courses.summary: Diffusion models as the new standard for generative AI behind image and video generation: theory, conditional generation, personalization and applications, with programming assignments.

courses.title: Introduction to Generative Models
courses.summary: Fundamental principles and recent advances of generative models that learn complex data distributions and sample from them, for vision, graphics, language and science.

courses.title: Machine Learning for 3D Data
courses.summary: Deep learning for 3D data such as scans and designed models, used in autonomous driving, 3D design, AR and robotics, with paper reviews and projects.

courses.title: Recent Advances in Deep Learning
courses.summary: Recent foundation models: LLM architectures, pre- and post-training recipes, inference and test-time compute, LLM agents, multimodal and video diffusion models, vision-language-action and world models.

courses.title: Deep Learning (iAI Lab teaching materials)
courses.summary: Openly available deep learning materials with slides, Colab notebooks and Korean/English videos: ML basics, ANN, CNN, autoencoders, self-supervised learning, detection, GANs and diffusion models.

courses.title: Introduction to Machine Learning
courses.summary: Fundamental concepts of machine learning, including supervised, unsupervised and reinforcement learning, with the underlying model architectures, algorithms and math; slides linked from the schedule.

courses.title: Representation Learning
